changelog: Notes+ 19.9: Undo and Redo in text, journal and list notes, and Sync now in a note's menu. Sync improvements: update Notes+ on every device you use. Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ 19.9 for Windows: Ctrl+Z works in text notes again, the formatting bar stays at the top, and Sync now in a note's menu. Update Notes+ on every device you use.

linux.changelog: Notes+ 19.9 for Linux: Ctrl+Z works in text notes again, the formatting bar stays at the top, and Sync now in a note's menu.

web.changelog: Notes+ on the web 19.9: undo that follows every edit in text notes, and Sync now in a note's menu.
